'''Tad Barran'''{{ref|Last name finally given in {{11|29}}.}} is one of the stablemen at the [[Winespring Inn]] in [[Emond's Field]]. His brother is [[Hu Barran|Hu]].

== Appearance ==
He is lanky.{{ref/book|4|44}}

== Activities ==
When [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and [[Tamlin al'Thor]] come to Emond's Field, Tad and Hu take [[Bela]] and the wagon to the Winespring Inn's stable.{{ref/book|1|2}} As the al'Thor's are leaving, Tam briefly speaks with the brothers.{{ref/book|1|4}}

When [[Perrin Aybara]] returns to Emond's Field, he hears Tad and Hu working in the stable.{{ref/book|4|29}} Later, he and his brother bring out [[Stepper]] and [[Swallow]] for Perrin and [[Faile Bashere|Faile]].{{ref/book|4|44}}

Tad helps defend Emond's Field against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}

He [[Travel]]s through [[Jur Grady]]'s [[Gateway]] to join the rest of the [[Two Rivers]] men taken by Perrin Aybara. He also participates in the [[Battle of Malden]].{{ref/book|11|29}}
